results.description:
The new surfing romance for 2026 that will carry you away…

Sun, surf and secrets…

World-renowned surfer Jade fled to a tropical paradise to heal her broken heart—not risk it again. But when she meets the brooding Axel their chemistry proves impossible to ignore.

Axel built his quiet island life to escape his demons. The last thing he needs is the addictive presence of a woman who makes him feel alive again—especially one who could shatter the fragile peace he's created.

As passion ignites beneath the island sun, Jade must decide if love is worth the risk. But can their connection survive when Axel's dark secrets surface?

Readers can't wait to dive Into the Blue…

'Such an escapist read…I've really enjoyed every book in this trio.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

'Into The Blue certainly didn't disappoint. I thought it was the perfect summer beach read.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐

'A mix of romance, self-discovery, and a beautiful setting, this was the perfect escape.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐

'The perfect summer escape…the tropical island setting was beautifully immersive and made me want to pack my bags immediately.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐

'This trilogy is the perfect summer read, and it’s got my wanderlust at an all-time high.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐

About the author

Isadora Love has travelled the world, lived in a few different places, and visited most of the surf locations featured in these books. (She might have kissed a surfer or two as well, but that's another story). When she's not writing, she likes to paint, travel, watch live music and hang out with her family and friends.

Isadora also writes fantasy romance under the name Helen Glynn Jones.
